items.name: Astra
items.description: Ghanaian Agent Astra harnesses the energies of the cosmos to reshape battlefields to her whim. With full command of her astral form and a talent for deep strategic foresight, she's always eons ahead of her enemy's next move.

role.name: Controller
role.description: Controllers are experts in slicing up dangerous territory to set their team up for success.

abilities.name: Gravity Well
abilities.description: ACTIVATE a Star to create a zone that pulls all players to the center, exploding and applying vulnerable to all players.

abilities.name: Nova Pulse
abilities.description: ACTIVATE a Star to detonate it, concussing all players hit.

abilities.name: Nebula
abilities.description: ACTIVATE a Star to transform it into a smoke.

abilities.name: Cosmic Divide
abilities.description: ENTER Astral Form. ALT FIRE to EQUIP Cosmic Divide. FIRE to set, pivot and FIRE again to create an indestructible wall that blocks audio.

abilities.name: Astral Form
abilities.description:
ACTIVATE ULTIMATE to ENTER Astral Form. FIRE to cast Stars. 

INTERACT to recall a Star. Recalling a Star forms a brief smoke.

items.name: Breach
items.description: The bionic Swede Breach fires powerful, targeted kinetic blasts to aggressively clear a path through enemy ground. The damage and disruption he inflicts ensures no fight is ever fair.

role.name: Initiator
role.description: Initiators challenge angles by setting up their team to enter contested ground and push defenders away.

abilities.name: Aftershock
abilities.description: EQUIP Aftershock. FIRE to send a zone through a wall, exploding to repeatedly deal damage to all players.

abilities.name: Flashpoint
abilities.description: EQUIP a Flashpoint. FIRE to send it through a wall, exploding to flash all players looking at it.

abilities.name: Fault Line
abilities.description: EQUIP Fault Line. HOLD FIRE to increase distance. RELEASE to detonate a zone that concusses all players.

abilities.name: Rolling Thunder
abilities.description: EQUIP Rolling Thunder. FIRE to send forward a wave that concusses and knocks up all players.

items.name: Brimstone
items.description: Joining from the U.S.A., Brimstone's orbital arsenal ensures his squad always has the advantage. His ability to deliver utility precisely and safely make him the unmatched boots-on-the-ground commander.

role.name: Controller
role.description: Controllers are experts in slicing up dangerous territory to set their team up for success.

abilities.name: Stim Beacon
abilities.description: INSTANTLY throw a Stim Beacon. On landing, create a zone that grants combat stim and haste to allies.

abilities.name: Incendiary
abilities.description: EQUIP Incendiary. FIRE to launch. On landing, create a zone that deals damage to all players.

abilities.name: Sky Smoke
abilities.description: EQUIP a tactical map. FIRE to set smoke locations. ALT FIRE to cast smokes.

abilities.name: Orbital Strike
abilities.description: EQUIP a tactical map. FIRE to cast an Orbital Strike at a location, dealing high damage over time to all players.

items.name: Chamber
items.description: Well-dressed and well-armed, French weapons designer Chamber expels aggressors with deadly precision. He leverages his custom arsenal to hold the line and pick off enemies from afar, with a contingency built for every plan.

role.name: Sentinel
role.description: Sentinels are defensive experts who can lock down areas and watch flanks, both on attacker and defender rounds.

abilities.name: Trademark
abilities.description:
EQUIP a destructible Trademark. FIRE to place. Triggers on nearby visible enemies in range, creating a zone that slows all players.

Can be recalled.

abilities.name: Headhunter
abilities.description: EQUIP Headhunter. FIRE to shoot. ALT FIRE to aim down sights.

abilities.name: Rendezvous
abilities.description:
EQUIP a destructible Rendezvous. FIRE to place. While in range, REACTIVATE to instantly teleport to it.

Can be recalled.

abilities.name: Tour De Force
abilities.description:
ACTIVATE to access a sniper rifle that deals lethal damage with direct hits to the upper body.

FIRE to shoot. ALT FIRE to aim down sights. On kills, create a zone that slows all players.

items.name: Clove
items.description: Scottish troublemaker Clove makes mischief for enemies in both the heat of combat and the cold of death. The young immortal keeps foes guessing, even from beyond the grave, their return to the living only ever a moment away.

role.name: Controller
role.description: Controllers are experts in slicing up dangerous territory to set their team up for success.

abilities.name: Pick-me-up
abilities.description: ACTIVATE on a targeted dead enemy that you damaged or killed to gain haste and overheal.

abilities.name: Meddle
abilities.description: EQUIP Meddle. FIRE to throw. Explodes on landing, decaying all players.

abilities.name: Ruse
abilities.description:
EQUIP a tactical map. FIRE to set smoke locations. ALT FIRE to cast smokes.

While dead, Clove can access Ruse to cast brief smokes.

abilities.name: Not Dead Yet
abilities.description: On death, ACTIVATE to channel a self-resurrect. During the channel, Clove is intangible. REACTIVATE to end the channel early. Once resurrected, secure a kill or damaging assist to stay alive.

items.name: Cypher
items.description: The Moroccan information broker, Cypher is a one-man surveillance network who keeps tabs on the enemy's every move. No secret is safe. No maneuver goes unseen. Cypher is always watching.

role.name: Sentinel
role.description: Sentinels are defensive experts who can lock down areas and watch flanks, both on attacker and defender rounds.

abilities.name: Trapwire
abilities.description:
EQUIP a destructible Trapwire. FIRE to place a wire between surfaces. Trapwire stealths after placement. Triggers when enemies come in contact, tethering enemies, and after a delay, revealing them if Trapwire is not destroyed.

Can be picked up.

abilities.name: Cyber Cage
abilities.description:
INSTANTLY throw a Cyber Cage. INTERACT to create a vision-blocking cylinder that plays an audio cue when enemies come in contact.

Can be picked up during BUY PHASE.

abilities.name: Spycam
abilities.description:
EQUIP a destructible Spycam. FIRE to place. Spycam stealths after placement. REACTIVATE to control it. FIRE to shoot a dart that snapshots enemies hit until they remove it.

Can be picked up.

abilities.name: Neural Theft
abilities.description: ACTIVATE on a targeted dead enemy. After a delay, snapshot living enemies twice.

items.name: Deadlock
items.description: Norwegian operative Deadlock deploys an array of cutting-edge nanowire to secure the battlefield from even the most lethal assault. No one escapes her vigilant watch, nor survives her unyielding ferocity.

role.name: Sentinel
role.description: Sentinels are defensive experts who can lock down areas and watch flanks, both on attacker and defender rounds.

abilities.name: Barrier Mesh
abilities.description: EQUIP Barrier Mesh. FIRE to throw. On landing, create destructible markers that fortify after a delay. These markers form barriers that block player movement.

abilities.name: Sonic Sensor
abilities.description:
EQUIP a destructible Sonic Sensor. FIRE to place. Triggers on nearby detected enemy noise, creating a zone that concusses all players. Sonic Sensor stealths after placement.

Can be picked up.

abilities.name: GravNet
abilities.description: EQUIP GravNet. FIRE to throw. ALT FIRE to lob. Explodes on landing, forcing all players to crouch and move slowly until they remove the net.

abilities.name: Annihilation
abilities.description: EQUIP Annihilation. FIRE to launch a zone, forcing the first enemy caught into a destructible cocoon that pulls them along a path for lethal damage unless the cocoon is destroyed.

items.name: Fade
items.description: Turkish bounty hunter Fade unleashes the power of raw nightmare to seize enemy secrets. Attuned with terror itself, she hunts down targets and reveals their deepest fears - before crushing them in the dark.

role.name: Initiator
role.description: Initiators challenge angles by setting up their team to enter contested ground and push defenders away.

abilities.name: Prowler
abilities.description: EQUIP a destructible Prowler. FIRE to send it forward. HOLD FIRE to steer towards your crosshair. Chases the first enemy or Terror Trail it sees, nearsighting on impact.

abilities.name: Seize
abilities.description: EQUIP Seize. FIRE to throw. REACTIVATE to drop early. On landing, deafen, decay, and tether enemies.

abilities.name: Haunt
abilities.description: EQUIP a destructible Haunt. FIRE to throw. REACTIVATE to drop early. On landing, mark and reveal enemies in range and line of sight.

abilities.name: Nightfall
abilities.description: EQUIP Nightfall. FIRE to send forward a wave that deafens, decays, and marks enemies.

abilities.name: Terror Trails
abilities.description: Marked enemies have their location tracked by Terror Trails.

items.name: Gekko
items.description: Gekko the Angeleno leads a tight-knit crew of calamitous creatures. His buddies bound forward, scattering enemies out of the way, with Gekko chasing them down to regroup and go again.

role.name: Initiator
role.description: Initiators challenge angles by setting up their team to enter contested ground and push defenders away.

abilities.name: Mosh Pit
abilities.description:
EQUIP Mosh. FIRE to throw. ALT FIRE to lob. On landing, create a zone that deals low damage over time before exploding, dealing high damage to all players.

Reverts to a Globule.

abilities.name: Wingman
abilities.description:
EQUIP a destructible Wingman. FIRE to send it forward. Chases the first enemy it sees, concussing on impact. ALT FIRE to have Wingman plant or defuse at a targeted bomb site.

Reverts to a Globule.

abilities.name: Dizzy
abilities.description:
EQUIP a destructible Dizzy. FIRE to throw. Fires plasma at enemies in line of sight, blinding them.

Reverts to a Globule.

abilities.name: Thrash
abilities.description:
EQUIP a destructible Thrash. FIRE to take control. FIRE again to lunge and explode, detaining all players. FIRE while lunging to explode early.

Reverts to a Globule only once.

abilities.name: Globule
abilities.description:
Gekko’s abilities transform into a Globule after use.

INTERACT to reclaim nearby Globules to gain another charge after a short cooldown.

items.name: Harbor
items.description: Hailing from India’s coast, Harbor storms the field wielding ancient technology with dominion over water. He unleashes frothing rapids and crushing waves to shield his allies, or pummel those that oppose him.

role.name: Controller
role.description: Controllers are experts in slicing up dangerous territory to set their team up for success.

abilities.name: Storm Surge
abilities.description: EQUIP Storm Surge. FIRE to throw. Explodes on landing, nearsighting and slowing all players.

abilities.name: High Tide
abilities.description: EQUIP High Tide. FIRE to send forward a vision-blocking wall that slows all players who come in contact. HOLD FIRE to steer towards your crosshair. ALT FIRE to stop early.

abilities.name: Cove
abilities.description: ENTER The Deep. REACTIVATE to cast a smoke. HOLD FIRE/ALT FIRE to adjust distance. RELOAD to toggle view. After casting, REACTIVATE to transform the smoke into a destructible shield.

abilities.name: Reckoning
abilities.description: EQUIP Reckoning. FIRE to push forward a vision-blocking wall that nearsights and slows all players who come in contact. REACTIVATE to stop the wall early.

items.name: Hush
items.description: Chinese operative Hush uses her telekinesis to close the most classified cases. Fighting with precision and finesse, she redirects her combat utility in midair to disrupt and displace the enemy team before suspending them helplessly for the killing blow.

role.name: Duelist
role.description: Duelists are self-sufficient fraggers who their team expects, through abilities and skills, to get high frags and seek out engagements first.

abilities.name: Flow
abilities.description: INSTANTLY create an anchor. If Hush is in the air, briefly levitate in place. After a delay, propel towards it.

abilities.name: Flashbulb
abilities.description: EQUIP Flashbulb. FIRE to throw. ALT FIRE to prepare it instead. REACTIVATE to direct it towards your crosshair. Explodes on any surface or after a delay, flashing all players looking at it.

abilities.name: Displacement
abilities.description:
EQUIP Displacement. FIRE to throw. ALT FIRE to prepare it instead. REACTIVATE to direct it towards your crosshair. Explodes on any surface or after a delay, pulling all players towards the center and concussing them if they collide with any surface or another player.

Resets every two kills.

abilities.name: Suspension
abilities.description: INSTANTLY prepare Suspension. FIRE to send it forward, steering with your crosshair. REACTIVATE or press FIRE again to detonate, levitating all players.

abilities.name: Telekinesis
abilities.description: Hush can pick up weapons, the Spike, and INTERACT with switches from an increased range.

items.name: Iso
items.description: Chinese fixer for hire Iso falls into a flow state to dismantle the opposition. Reconfiguring ambient energy into bulletproof protection, he advances with focus towards his next duel to the death.

role.name: Duelist
role.description: Duelists are self-sufficient fraggers who their team expects, through abilities and skills, to get high frags and seek out engagements first.

abilities.name: Contingency
abilities.description: EQUIP Contingency. FIRE to push forward an indestructible vision-blocking wall. ALT FIRE for a slower wall.

abilities.name: Undercut
abilities.description: EQUIP Undercut. FIRE to send it forward. Applies suppress and vulnerable to all players.

abilities.name: Double Tap
abilities.description: INSTANTLY channel Focus. Gain a shield that blocks one instance of damage.

abilities.name: Kill Contract
abilities.description:
EQUIP Kill Contract. FIRE to send forward a zone that pulls you and the first enemy hit into a duel.

Channel Focus at the start of a duel.

abilities.name: Focus
abilities.description:
While Focused, reload faster and spawn destructible energy orbs from dead enemies Iso has damaged or killed.

When an energy orb is shot, grant a shield that blocks one instance of damage and refresh Focus.

items.name: Jett
items.description: Representing her home country of South Korea, Jett's agile and evasive fighting style lets her take risks no one else can. She runs circles around every skirmish, cutting enemies up before they even know what hit them.

role.name: Duelist
role.description: Duelists are self-sufficient fraggers who their team expects, through abilities and skills, to get high frags and seek out engagements first.

abilities.name: Cloudburst
abilities.description: INSTANTLY throw a cloud. Forms into a brief smoke on any surface or after a delay. HOLD ACTIVATE to steer towards your crosshair.

abilities.name: Updraft
abilities.description: INSTANTLY propel high into the air.

abilities.name: Tailwind
abilities.description:
INSTANTLY prepare a dash. REACTIVATE to dash forward or in your movement direction.

Resets every two kills.

abilities.name: Blade Storm
abilities.description:
INSTANTLY access five accurate throwing knives that deal lethal damage with direct hits to the head.

FIRE to shoot. On kills, refresh your knives. ALT FIRE to throw all remaining knives without a refresh.

abilities.name: Drift
abilities.description: HOLD JUMP while falling to glide.

items.name: KAY/O
items.description: KAY/O is a machine of war built for a single purpose: neutralizing radiants. His power to Suppress enemy abilities dismantles his opponents' capacity to fight back, securing him and his allies the ultimate edge.

role.name: Initiator
role.description: Initiators challenge angles by setting up their team to enter contested ground and push defenders away.

abilities.name: FRAG/ment
abilities.description: EQUIP FRAG/ment. FIRE to throw. ALT FIRE to lob. Explodes on landing, repeatedly dealing pulses of damage to all players.

abilities.name: FLASH/drive
abilities.description: EQUIP a FLASH/drive. FIRE to throw. ALT FIRE to lob. After a delay, explode, flashing all players looking at it.

abilities.name: ZERO/point
abilities.description: EQUIP a destructible ZERO/point. FIRE to throw. Pulses on any surface, suppressing enemies within range.

abilities.name: NULL/cmd
abilities.description:
INSTANTLY gain overloaded and repeatedly send out a pulse that suppresses enemies within range.

Overloaded grants combat stim. Upon taking lethal damage, KAY/O is downed and can be re-stabilized.

items.name: Killjoy
items.description: The genius of Germany, Killjoy effortlessly secures key battlefield positions with her arsenal of inventions. If their damage doesn't take her enemies out, the debuff her robots provide will make short work of them.

role.name: Sentinel
role.description: Sentinels are defensive experts who can lock down areas and watch flanks, both on attacker and defender rounds.

abilities.name: Nanoswarm
abilities.description:
EQUIP a destructible Nanoswarm. FIRE to throw. ALT FIRE to lob. Nanoswarm stealths after landing. INTERACT to create a zone that deals damage to all players.

Can be picked up during BUY PHASE.

abilities.name: ALARMBOT
abilities.description:
EQUIP a destructible Alarmbot. FIRE to place. Alarmbot stealths after placement. Triggers on nearby visible enemies in range. Chases the first enemy it sees, exploding and applying vulnerable.

Can be recalled.

abilities.name: TURRET
abilities.description:
EQUIP a destructible Turret. While equipped, REACTIVATE to flip the direction or HOLD ALT FIRE to rotate. FIRE to place. Shoots at enemies in line of sight.

Can be recalled.

abilities.name: Lockdown
abilities.description: EQUIP a destructible Lockdown. FIRE to prepare a zone. After a delay, detain enemies within range.

items.name: Miks
items.description: Straight from Croatia, Miks takes the stage channeling pure sound energy. With his infectious passion and sonic powers, he rallies his squad to move as one as they set the tempo on the battlefield together.

role.name: Controller
role.description: Controllers are experts in slicing up dangerous territory to set their team up for success.

abilities.name: M-pulse
abilities.description: EQUIP a destructible M-Pulse. ALT FIRE to toggle between concuss or heal. FIRE to throw. Repeatedly pulses on landing, applying the selected effect on all players within range.

abilities.name: Harmonize
abilities.description: EQUIP Harmonize. FIRE on a targeted ally to grant combat stim and haste to them and yourself. On kills while active, refresh the buff if both Harmonized players are still alive. ALT FIRE to self-cast with no refresh.

abilities.name: Waveform
abilities.description: EQUIP a tactical map. FIRE to set smoke locations. ALT FIRE to cast smokes.

abilities.name: Bassquake
abilities.description: EQUIP Bassquake. FIRE to send forward a zone that deafens, knocks back, and slows all players.

items.name: Neon
items.description: Filipino Agent Neon surges forward at shocking speeds, discharging bursts of bioelectric radiance as fast as her body generates it. She races ahead to catch enemies off guard then strikes them down quicker than lightning.

role.name: Duelist
role.description: Duelists are self-sufficient fraggers who their team expects, through abilities and skills, to get high frags and seek out engagements first.

abilities.name: Fast Lane
abilities.description: INSTANTLY launch two vision-blocking walls that extend until they hit a surface.

abilities.name: Relay Bolt
abilities.description: INSTANTLY throw a bolt that bounces once. Explodes on each surface, concussing all players.

abilities.name: High Gear
abilities.description:
INSTANTLY consume fuel to gain haste. REACTIVATE to cancel. ALT FIRE to slide forward or in your movement direction.

Slide resets every two kills.

abilities.name: Overdrive
abilities.description:
INSTANTLY refresh High Gear. Access an accurate lightning beam that can be used while activating High Gear.

FIRE to shoot. On kills, fully recharge fuel.

abilities.name: Battery
abilities.description: Passively recharge fuel over time.

items.name: Omen
items.description: A phantom of a memory, Omen hunts in the shadows. He renders enemies blind, teleports across the field, then lets paranoia take hold as his foe scrambles to uncover where he might strike next.

role.name: Controller
role.description: Controllers are experts in slicing up dangerous territory to set their team up for success.

abilities.name: Shrouded Step
abilities.description: EQUIP a Shrouded Step. FIRE to briefly channel, then teleport to a targeted location.

abilities.name: Paranoia
abilities.description: EQUIP Paranoia. FIRE to send it forward. Applies nearsight and deafens all players.

abilities.name: Dark Cover
abilities.description: ENTER Shadow Vision. REACTIVATE to cast a smoke. HOLD FIRE/ALT FIRE to adjust distance. RELOAD to toggle view.

abilities.name: From the Shadows
abilities.description: EQUIP a tactical map. FIRE to begin a teleport to a selected location. While teleporting, Omen appears as a destructible shade at the destination. REACTIVATE to cancel.

items.name: Phoenix
items.description: Hailing from the U.K., Phoenix's star power shines through in his fighting style, igniting the battlefield with flash and flare. Whether he's got backup or not, he's rushing in to fight on his own terms.

role.name: Duelist
role.description: Duelists are self-sufficient fraggers who their team expects, through abilities and skills, to get high frags and seek out engagements first.

abilities.name: Blaze
abilities.description: EQUIP Blaze. FIRE to send forward a vision-blocking fire wall that deals damage to all players. HOLD FIRE to steer towards your crosshair.

abilities.name: Hot Hands
abilities.description: EQUIP Hot Hands. FIRE to throw. ALT FIRE to lob. On landing, create a fire zone that deals damage to all players.

abilities.name: Curveball
abilities.description:
EQUIP a Curveball. FIRE to curve left, ALT FIRE to curve right. After a delay, explode, flashing all players looking at it.

Resets every two kills.

abilities.name: Run it Back
abilities.description: INSTANTLY place a marker at your location. Upon taking lethal damage or when Run it Back expires, return to the marker with full health and the amount of armor you had when the ability was activated.

abilities.name: Inner Fire
abilities.description: Phoenix heals while standing in his own fire instead of taking damage.

items.name: Raze
items.description: Raze explodes out of Brazil with her big personality and big guns. With her blunt-force-trauma playstyle, she excels at flushing entrenched enemies and clearing tight spaces with a generous dose of "boom."

role.name: Duelist
role.description: Duelists are self-sufficient fraggers who their team expects, through abilities and skills, to get high frags and seek out engagements first.

abilities.name: Boom Bot
abilities.description: EQUIP a destructible Boom Bot. FIRE to send it forward. Chases the first enemy it sees, exploding and dealing damage to enemies on impact.

abilities.name: Blast Pack
abilities.description:
INSTANTLY throw a destructible Blast Pack that sticks to surfaces that fully arms after a delay. REACTIVATE to detonate, knocking away anything hit.

If fully armed, Blast Pack will also deal damage to enemies.

abilities.name: Paint Shells
abilities.description:
EQUIP Paint Shells. FIRE to throw. ALT FIRE to lob. After a delay, explode, dealing damage and creating sub-munitions, each also dealing damage to all players.

Resets every two kills.

abilities.name: Showstopper
abilities.description: INSTANTLY prepare Showstopper. FIRE to launch. Explodes on any surface, dealing high damage to all players.

items.name: Reyna
items.description: Forged in the heart of Mexico, Reyna dominates single combat, popping off with each kill she scores. Her capability is only limited by her raw skill, making her sharply dependent on performance.

role.name: Duelist
role.description: Duelists are self-sufficient fraggers who their team expects, through abilities and skills, to get high frags and seek out engagements first.

abilities.name: Leer
abilities.description: EQUIP a destructible Leer. FIRE to send. After a delay, form, nearsighting enemies looking at it.

abilities.name: Devour
abilities.description:
INSTANTLY consume a Soul Orb to heal. Excess healing is converted into overheal.

While ULTIMATE is active, Devour auto-casts.

abilities.name: Dismiss
abilities.description:
INSTANTLY consume a Soul Orb to briefly become intangible. REACTIVATE to cancel early.

While ULTIMATE is active, also gain invisibility.

abilities.name: Empress
abilities.description:
INSTANTLY gain empress.

Empress grants combat stim, endless Soul Orb consumption, and permanent overheal.

abilities.name: Vitality
abilities.description: Spawn a Soul Orb from dead enemies Reyna has damaged or killed.

items.name: Sage
items.description: The bastion of China, Sage creates safety for herself and her team wherever she goes. Able to revive fallen friends and stave off forceful assaults, she provides a calm center to a hellish battlefield.

role.name: Sentinel
role.description: Sentinels are defensive experts who can lock down areas and watch flanks, both on attacker and defender rounds.

abilities.name: Barrier Orb
abilities.description: EQUIP a destructible Barrier Orb. While equipped, REACTIVATE to pivot the wall or HOLD ALT FIRE to rotate. FIRE to place a destructible wall that fortifies after a delay.

abilities.name: Slow Orb
abilities.description: EQUIP a Slow Orb. FIRE to throw. On landing, create a zone that slows all players and plays an audio cue when enemies run through it.

abilities.name: Healing Orb
abilities.description: EQUIP Healing Orb. FIRE on a damaged ally to grant healing. ALT FIRE to self-cast.

abilities.name: Resurrection
abilities.description: EQUIP Resurrection. FIRE on a targeted dead ally to resurrect them.

items.name: Skye
items.description: Hailing from Australia, Skye and her band of beasts trailblaze the way through hostile territory. With her creations hampering the enemy, and her power to heal others, the team is strongest and safest by Skye's side.

role.name: Initiator
role.description: Initiators challenge angles by setting up their team to enter contested ground and push defenders away.

abilities.name: Regrowth
abilities.description:
EQUIP Regrowth. HOLD FIRE to heal allies in range and line of sight. Uses a limited healing pool.

Cannot heal self.

abilities.name: Trailblazer
abilities.description: EQUIP a destructible Trailblazer. FIRE to take control. FIRE again to lunge and explode, concussing all players and dealing damage to enemies on direct hits.

abilities.name: Guiding Light
abilities.description: EQUIP a Guiding Light. FIRE to send it forward. HOLD FIRE to steer towards your crosshair. REACTIVATE to detonate, flashing all players looking at it.

abilities.name: Seekers
abilities.description: EQUIP destructible Seekers. FIRE to send out up to three Seekers. Chases the three closest enemies, nearsighting and slowing on impact.

items.name: Sova
items.description: Born from the eternal winter of Russia's tundra, Sova tracks, finds, and eliminates enemies with ruthless efficiency and precision. His custom bow and incredible scouting abilities ensure that even if you run, you cannot hide.

role.name: Initiator
role.description: Initiators challenge angles by setting up their team to enter contested ground and push defenders away.

abilities.name: Owl Drone
abilities.description: EQUIP a destructible Owl Drone. FIRE to take control. FIRE again to shoot a dart that repeatedly reveals enemies.

abilities.name: Shock Bolt
abilities.description: EQUIP a Shock Bolt. FIRE to shoot a bolt that explodes on any surface, dealing damage to all players. HOLD FIRE to increase the bolt’s velocity. ALT FIRE to add up to two bounces.

abilities.name: Recon Bolt
abilities.description: EQUIP a destructible Recon Bolt. FIRE to shoot a bolt that repeatedly reveals nearby enemies in range and line of sight. HOLD FIRE to increase the bolt’s velocity. ALT FIRE to add up to two bounces.

abilities.name: Hunter's Fury
abilities.description:
EQUIP Hunter’s Fury. FIRE to shoot a zone that deals damage. Can be fired up to two more times.

Enemies hit are revealed to Sova.

items.name: Tejo
items.description: A veteran intelligence consultant from Colombia, Tejo’s ballistic guidance system pressures the enemy to relinquish their ground - or their lives. His targeted strikes keep opponents off balance and under his heel.

role.name: Initiator
role.description: Initiators challenge angles by setting up their team to enter contested ground and push defenders away.

abilities.name: Stealth Drone
abilities.description: EQUIP a destructible Stealth Drone. FIRE to take control. FIRE again to reveal and suppress nearby enemies in range and line of sight.

abilities.name: Special Delivery
abilities.description: EQUIP Special Delivery. FIRE to launch. ALT FIRE to launch with a bounce. Explodes on any surface, concussing and damaging all players.

abilities.name: Guided Salvo
abilities.description: EQUIP a tactical map. FIRE to set locations. ALT FIRE to launch missiles that travel to and repeatedly pulse, dealing damage to all players.

abilities.name: Armageddon
abilities.description: EQUIP a tactical map. FIRE to set, pivot and FIRE again to cast a wave that deals high damage to all players. ALT FIRE to cancel targeting.

items.name: Veto
items.description: Empowered by an unstoppable DNA mutation, Senegalese enforcer Veto defies the rules of engagement by nullifying his opponent's powers and technology. On Veto's battlefield, gunplay is your only guarantee.

role.name: Sentinel
role.description: Sentinels are defensive experts who can lock down areas and watch flanks, both on attacker and defender rounds.

abilities.name: Crosscut
abilities.description:
EQUIP a destructible Crosscut. FIRE to place. While in range, INTERACT to teleport to it.

Can be recalled during BUY PHASE.

abilities.name: Chokehold
abilities.description:
EQUIP a destructible Chokehold. FIRE to throw. Chokehold stealths after landing. Triggers on nearby visible enemies in range, deafening, decaying, and tethering enemies.

Can be recalled during BUY PHASE.

abilities.name: Interceptor
abilities.description:
EQUIP a destructible Interceptor. FIRE to place. REACTIVATE to activate. While active, destroy any enemy utility that can be shot or would bounce off players in range and line of sight.

Can be recalled.

abilities.name: Evolution
abilities.description:
INSTANTLY gain evolution.

Evolution grants combat stim, continuous healing, and immunity to all debuffs and damage, except weapons.

items.name: Viper
items.description: The American Chemist, Viper deploys an array of poisonous chemical devices to control the battlefield and choke the enemy's vision. If the toxins don't kill her prey, her mindgames surely will.

role.name: Controller
role.description: Controllers are experts in slicing up dangerous territory to set their team up for success.

abilities.name: Snake Bite
abilities.description: EQUIP Snake Bite. FIRE to launch. On landing, create a zone that grants vulnerable and deals low damage to all players.

abilities.name: Poison Cloud
abilities.description:
EQUIP Poison Cloud. FIRE to throw. ALT FIRE to lob. REACTIVATE to consume fuel to create a toxic smoke that decays enemies.

Can be picked up during BUY PHASE.

abilities.name: Toxic Screen
abilities.description: EQUIP Toxic Screen. FIRE to send forward and place a line of emitters. REACTIVATE to consume fuel to create a toxic vision-blocking wall that decays enemies.

abilities.name: Viper's Pit
abilities.description:
EQUIP Viper’s Pit. FIRE to form a large toxic vision-blocking cloud that decays enemies inside.

HOLD ACTIVATE to cancel the cloud.

abilities.name: Toxin
abilities.description: Viper’s Toxin continuously inflicts decay when enemies come in contact. Passively recharge fuel over time.

items.name: Vyse
items.description: Metallic mastermind Vyse unleashes liquid metal to isolate, trap, and disarm her enemies. Through cunning and manipulation, she forces all who oppose her to fear the battlefield itself.

role.name: Sentinel
role.description: Sentinels are defensive experts who can lock down areas and watch flanks, both on attacker and defender rounds.

abilities.name: Razorvine
abilities.description:
EQUIP a destructible Razorvine. FIRE to throw. Razorvine stealths after landing. INTERACT to create a zone that slows and deals damage when players move through it.

Can be recalled during BUY PHASE.

abilities.name: Shear
abilities.description:
EQUIP Shear. FIRE to place. Shear stealths after placement. Triggers when enemies walk on it, and after a delay, create a brief indestructible wall.

Can be recalled during BUY PHASE.

abilities.name: Arc Rose
abilities.description:
EQUIP a destructible Arc Rose. FIRE to place. ALT FIRE to place it through a wall. REACTIVATE to flash all players looking at it. 

Can be recalled.

abilities.name: Steel Garden
abilities.description: EQUIP Steel Garden. FIRE to prepare a zone. After a delay, jam enemy primary weapons within range.

items.name: Waylay
items.description: Thailand's prismatic radiant Waylay transforms into light itself as she darts across the battlefield, striking down her targets through shards of light before flitting back to safety, all in the blink of an eye.

role.name: Duelist
role.description: Duelists are self-sufficient fraggers who their team expects, through abilities and skills, to get high frags and seek out engagements first.

abilities.name: Saturate
abilities.description: EQUIP Saturate. FIRE to throw. Explodes on landing, hindering all players.

abilities.name: Lightspeed
abilities.description:
EQUIP Lightspeed. FIRE to dash forward twice. ALT FIRE to dash forward once.

Only the first dash can launch upward.

abilities.name: Refract
abilities.description:
INSTANTLY place a marker at your location. REACTIVATE to travel to it. While traveling, Waylay is immune but cannot see enemies.

Resets every two kills.

abilities.name: Convergent Paths
abilities.description: EQUIP Convergent Paths. FIRE to gain haste and send forward a zone that hinders all players.

items.name: Yoru
items.description: Japanese native Yoru rips holes straight through reality to infiltrate enemy lines unseen. Using deception and aggression in equal measure, he gets the drop on each target before they know where to look.

role.name: Duelist
role.description: Duelists are self-sufficient fraggers who their team expects, through abilities and skills, to get high frags and seek out engagements first.

abilities.name: FAKEOUT
abilities.description:
EQUIP Fakeout. FIRE to send a destructible clone forward. ALT FIRE to place a marker at your location. INTERACT to transform the marker into a clone.

Clones continuously walk forward and will turn toward the first enemy that shoots it, flashing all players looking at it.

abilities.name: BLINDSIDE
abilities.description: EQUIP Blindside. FIRE to throw. After bouncing off a surface, explode, flashing all players looking at it.

abilities.name: GATECRASH
abilities.description:
EQUIP a Gatecrash. FIRE to send it forward. ALT FIRE to place. REACTIVATE to teleport to it. INTERACT to fake a teleport.

Resets every two kills.

abilities.name: DIMENSIONAL DRIFT
abilities.description: EQUIP Dimensional Drift. FIRE to become intangible and invisible. Gatecrash is accessible during this state. REACTIVATE to exit early.
